mechanism_narrative: The three-week rise in WORKPLACES from -51.7 to -20.6 marks a durable return of commuting and workplace presence that mechanically raises weekday foot traffic in retail corridors, so RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks exceeds its last-28-day mean of -15.0.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -51.7 at t-2w to -20.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or below its last-28-day mean of -15.0 while WORKPLACES stays above -30 in every one of those weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A weekly TRANSIT mean above -45 marks the point where households resume non-essential discretionary trips; once crossed, retail visits follow within two weeks because transit and retail trips share the same trip chains.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -45 from below
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -53.9 at t-2w to -43.6 at t-0w, crossing the -45 line
failure_condition: In weeks where the TRANSIT weekly mean is above -45, RETAIL_REC fails to exceed -16.0 within the following two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline of RESIDENTIAL from 13.1 toward baseline and the rise of WORKPLACES shifts hours out of the home; this interaction, not either series alone, predicts that discretionary retail spending recovers faster than its own flat trend.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below +10 while WORKPLACES weekly mean rises above -25
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 13.1 to 7.1 while WORKPLACES rose from -51.7 to -20.6
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL is below +10 and WORKPLACES above -25 jointly, RETAIL_REC four weeks later is no higher than in weeks when neither condition holds.

mechanism_narrative: In a restriction-tightening regime where TRANSIT falls back below -50, mobility retrenchment severs retail trip chains and RETAIL_REC declines from -16.0, because retail-and-recreation is the first category curtailed when movement is restricted.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT printed -53.9 at t-2w and RESIDENTIAL peaked at 13.1
failure_condition: In tightening weeks where TRANSIT is below -50, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than over the prior 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive weeks of positive PARKS means signal that outdoor and discretionary out-of-home activity has normalized; the same trip-generation impulse lifts retail visits within one week, raising RETAIL_REC above its trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean stays above 0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS printed +6.1 at t-2w and +7.4 at t-0w with an intervening -7.3
failure_condition: After two consecutive weeks with PARKS above 0, RETAIL_REC in the next week is not above its trailing four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: The January post-holiday contraction: GROCERY_PHARM falling from +6.6 to -3.1 shows the holiday stock-up pulse has fully unwound, and the trip-frequency drop it leaves behind keeps RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean for the following month.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from +6.6 at t-3w to -3.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds -15.0 while GROCERY_PHARM remains below 0 throughout.

mechanism_narrative: Under capacity-limited retail rules, recovering TRANSIT and PARKS mobility is absorbed by outdoor and non-retail destinations first, so retail visits stay pinned near -16 and the next 28-day mean falls modestly below the last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean above -45 while RETAIL_REC has stayed within 1 point of its level for two weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC flat at -16.0 for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT recovered to -43.6
failure_condition: The next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-28-day mean while TRANSIT is above -45 and RETAIL_REC had been flat for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A RESIDENTIAL mean still above +7 keeps a large share of discretionary consumption at home, and with GROCERY_PHARM now negative at -3.1 the nearby-substitution channel that normally offsets retail losses is closed, so RETAIL_REC slips in the coming week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM turned negative at -3.1 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL held at +7.1
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the next week is above its trailing four-week mean while RESIDENTIAL is above +7 and GROCERY_PHARM is below 0.
